g.text: Our main entrance is at 225 E. Chicago Avenue. Family and visitor parking is across the street in the
Garage A at 222 E. Huron Street
. The Huron-Superior Parking Garage has entrances on both Huron and Superior; however,
it is easiest to use Huron Street entrance. A pedestrian bridge connects the garage to the 2nd floor of Lurie Children’s.
For wheelchair accessible van parking, please use Huron entrance and visit the customer service office on the 1st floor,
immediately to your right. If you use the Superior entrance, please take the northwest corner elevators to the ground level
and walk east on Superior to the crosswalk. You may also park at the Erie-Ontario garage a few blocks away at 321 E. Erie.
$12 for less than 7 hours and $16 for more than 7 hours.
Available for emergencies or for children with disabilities. Your car can be left with the valet on the driveway
accessed from Chicago Avenue and can be retrieved by crossing a pedestrian bridge to the 2nd floor of the parking garage.
$16 for less than 7 hours, $21 for 7–24 hours. Stays exceeding 24 hours will incur additional fees.
$13 for less than 7 hours, $18 for 7–24 hours. Stays exceeding 24 hours will incur additional fees.
Note: For extended stays or multiple appointments, please ask your nurse or social worker for off-site parking options and shuttle schedules
